outcome: Detect cheating, bots, account takeover and payment abuse across gameplay, device, account and commerce signals — without banning legitimate players
overview: Cheating, bot farms, account takeover and payment abuse adapt faster than static rules, and over-correction bans real players — the most expensive mistake an integrity team can make. This solution scores gameplay, device, account and commerce signals together, explains why a session or transaction looks suspicious, and routes cases to investigators with a working appeal path; suspicion is never treated as guilt and sanctions stay human. An 8–14-week historical proof of value back-tests against labelled outcomes before anything touches live players. Reference builds are specified for AWS and Azure, with Gulf data residency and regional payment-provider integration in scope.

benefits.text: Improve confirmed detection of cheating, bots and payment abuse at an agreed false-positive ceiling
benefits.limits: Basis: hypothesis. Measured against labelled historical outcomes on the customer’s own titles; adversaries adapt, so detection is a moving target rather than a fixed rate

benefits.text: Reduce chargebacks, item-fraud losses and the economy damage that follows undetected abuse
benefits.limits: Basis: hypothesis. Depends on payment-provider signal quality and the customer’s refund policy; confirmed only against finance records after the pilot

benefits.text: Shorten investigation time with reason codes, linked-account graphs and a logged appeal trail
benefits.source: Reference design capability, Redington Gaming catalogue
benefits.limits: Explanations describe the signals that fired, not proof of intent; the customer’s investigators remain the decision-makers

residency: Deployable in-country on local AWS or Azure regions (e.g. UAE, KSA); gameplay, device, account and commerce signals remain in the customer tenancy in the reference designs, with minimisation applied to client telemetry

notFor.situation: No labelled outcomes — no confirmed cheats, bans or chargeback records
notFor.why: Detection lift and false-positive rate can only be measured against known-good and known-bad cases; without labels the back-test proves nothing

notFor.situation: No investigation team or appeal process
notFor.why: The design never auto-bans; scores route to a human case queue, so without investigators the output has nowhere to go and false bans cannot be corrected

notFor.situation: Client-side telemetry the customer is unwilling or unable to collect lawfully
notFor.why: Gameplay and device signals carry privacy weight; where collection is not lawful or proportionate, the signal set is too thin to separate cheating from skill

scope:
Model: Joint delivery: accredited implementation partner leads, with Redington architecture and commercial governance; the customer owns sanction policy, the false-positive ceiling, investigation decisions and appeal outcomes · Duration: 8–14-week proof of value; further 16–28 weeks to full production
Delivery pod: Partner delivery lead + project manager, fraud and anti-cheat data scientist, graph and payments engineer; customer game-integrity lead, security architect, payments and finance analysts, appeals reviewer · Support model: Business-hours or 24×7 option; severity-based response targets; partner service desk with vendor escalation
1) Discovery and loss and detection baseline agreement
2) Signal integration across gameplay, account, device and commerce
3) Rule, model and graph build with historical back-testing
4) Intervention, case-management and appeals configuration
5) Controlled live pilot with weekly integrity review
6) Stabilisation and handover
deliverables: Detection lift demonstrated on labelled history with the false-positive ceiling respected
Scoring latency and load tests passed at peak concurrent volumes
Privacy and security review passed, including client-telemetry minimisation
Intervention and appeal user-acceptance testing complete with investigators
Adversarial and rollback tests passed, including a rapid disable of any single detection
